training_policy: Per role/layer first formal saved cohort only;mapping held fixed for later saved cohorts. No later evaluation token/count data used to construct mappings.

algorithms.count_balanced: Descending training expert assignment count;choose lowest loaded rank with fewer than E slots.
algorithms.co_selection_capacity: Greedy pair-affinity clustering into exactly E expert slots;greedy cluster-to-rank labels maximize training local assignment affinity.
algorithms.within_TP8: Restrict expert owner to its original rank-index half of eight. This is a logical partition,not an asserted physical link.
